violation_type.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available (26 TAC §747.2505(2))
violation_type.short_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Pre-Kindergarten Age - Enough Available
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have age-appropriate activities for the children to engage in.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have age-appropriate activities for the children to engage in.
The applicant did not have enough items  so that prekindergarten age children are routinely engaged in either solitary, parallel, or group play.
